name: pollution_trunc_curves
description: Truncation and curve patterns (no numbered 11 test). Slot 53 truncates through the CRT _ftol (foundations 18.1): an int64 truncation of which the low 32 bits are kept, not a saturation. Powered incinerator with base 3,000,000,000 and efficiency 2.0: f32(3e9 x 2) = 6e9 exactly -> int64 6,000,000,000 -> low 32 bits 1,705,032,704 (6e9 - 2^32; the earlier saturating conversion gave 4,294,967,295). Curves (foundations 4.1, 4.3, props::curve): a per-occupant condition curve 0x8A1E07EE present with no points is an empty curve, which evaluates to 0: base 1000 at efficiency 1 -> roundHalfEven(1000 x 0) = 0, and slot 56 reports (true, 0); a single value (scalar 0.5) counts as absent -> 1000 unchanged and slot 56 (false, 1.0). Tuning: the decay curves 0x0911E2E8 (funding) and 0x0911E2E9 (usage) given as single values count as absent, so they keep their default constant 1 (7.1 'default' pattern): the monthly aging of an incinerator with k = 10 (0xEA1CF220), condition 0 and no usage adds usage(0) x funding(1.0) x 10 = 10; with both curves present and empty they evaluate to 0 and the condition stays 10. Hand-derived.
